{{nihongo|'''Unanenofushimino Shrine'''|宇流冨志禰神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Iga Province]].

'''Urufushine Shrine''' (うるふしねじんじゃ) is a shrine {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=enshrined}} in Hirao, {{ill|Nabari, Mie|ar|ناباري (ميه)|azb|ناباری، میه|ce|Набари|ceb|Nabari (lungsod)|ckb|ناباری (میێ)|de|Nabari|eo|Nabari|es|Nabari (Mie)|et|Nabari|fa|ناباری، میه|fi|Nabari|fr|Nabari (Mie)|gl|Nabari|id|Nabari, Mie|it|Nabari|ja|名張市|ko|나바리시|mg|Nabari|mzn|ناباری، میه|nl|Nabari|pl|Nabari (miasto)|pt|Nabari|ro|Nabari|ru|Набари|sh|Nabari|sr|Набари|sv|Nabari, Mie|tg|Набари|tl|Nabari, Mie|tr|Nabari|tt|Набари|uk|Набарі (Міє)|ur|نباری، میہ|uz|Nabari (Mie)|vi|Nabari, Mie|war|Nabari, Mie|zh|名張市|zh_classical|名張市|zh_min_nan|Nabari-chhī|zh_yue|名張|qid=Q166183}}, {{ill|Mie Prefecture|Q128196|qid=Q128196}}.

It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former rank was {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=kensha|qid=Q90139226}}.

Today, the character for "fu" in Urufushine is commonly written as "冨".<ref>{{Cite web|title=Urufushine Shrine|url=http://urufushine.jp/|access-date=2025-9-2}}</ref>

About the origin of the main deity Unane-no-Mikoto, it is explained as deriving from "(Nabari) River meanders => unane."<ref>{{Cite web|title=Urufushine Shrine|url=http://urufushine.jp/intro.html#a03|access-date=2025-9-1}}</ref>

"Benten-iwa" on the Nabari River bank west of the shrine is the sacred body<ref>{{Cite web|title=Urufushine Shrine Rock Festival|website=Iwa net|url=https://iwashinbun.com/?special=%e5%ae%87%e6%b5%81%e5%86%a8%e5%bf%97%e7%a6%b0%e7%a5%9e%e7%a4%be-%e5%b2%a9%e7%a5%ad%e3%82%8a|access-date=2025-11-7}}</ref>.

=== History ===
In {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 8 ({{ill|1580|ab|1580|af|1580|als|1580|am|1580 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1580|ar|1580|ary|1580|arz|1580|ast|1580|avk|1580|ay|1580|az|1580|azb|۱۵۸۰ (میلادی)|ban|1580|bar|1580|bcl|1580|be|1580|be_x_old|1580|bg|1580|bn|১৫৮০|bpy|মারি ১৫৮০|br|1580|bs|1580.|ca|1580|cdo|1580 nièng|ceb|1580|ckb|١٥٨٠|crh|1580|cs|1580|cv|1580|cy|1580|da|1580|de|1580|diq|1580|el|1580|eml|1580|eo|1580|es|1580|et|1580|eu|1580|fa|۱۵۸۰ (میلادی)|fi|1580|fo|1580|fr|1580|frr|1580|fur|1580|fy|1580|ga|1580|gan|1580年|gcr|1580|gd|1580|gl|1580|gv|1580|he|1580|hi|१५८०|hr|1580.|hsb|1580|ht|1580 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1580|hy|1580|hyw|1580 թուական|ia|1580|id|1580|ilo|1580|io|1580|is|1580|it|1580|ja|1580年|jv|1580|ka|1580|kaa|1580|kk|1580 жыл|ko|1580년|krc|1580 джыл|la|1580|lb|1580|lij|1580|lmo|1580|lt|1580 m.|lv|1580. gads|mai|१५८०|map_bms|1580|mdf|1580|mg|1580|mhr|1580|mi|1580|min|1580|mk|1580|mr|इ.स. १५८०|mrj|1580 и|ms|1580|my|၁၅၈၀|myv|1580 ие|mzn|۱۵۸۰|nah|1580|nap|1580|nds|1580|new|सन् १५८०|nl|1580|nn|1580|no|1580|nrm|1580|nso|1580|oc|1580|or|୧୫୮୦|os|1580-æм аз|pa|1580|pl|1580|pnb|1580|pt|1580|qu|1580|ro|1580|ru|1580 год|rue|1580|sa|१५८०|sah|1580|sc|1580|scn|1580|sd|1580ع|se|1580|sh|1580.|shn|1580|simple|1580|sk|1580|sl|1580|smn|1580|sq|1580|sr|1580|su|1580|sv|1580|sw|1580|ta|1580|tg|Соли 1580|th|พ.ศ. 2123|tk|1580|tl|1580|tly|1580|tr|1580|tt|1580 ел|uk|1580|ur|1580ء|uz|1580|vec|1580|vi|1580|vls|1580|wa|1580|war|1580|wuu|1580年|xmf|1580|yi|1580|zh|1580年|zh_min_nan|1580 nî|zh_yue|1580年|qid=Q6712}}), all shrine buildings, treasures, and old documents were lost in the {{ill|Tenshō Iga War|Q15436846|qid=Q15436846}}.

Founding is unknown. The 'Kasuga Shaki' says that in {{ill|Jingo-keiun|Q1373049|qid=Q1373049}} 1 ({{ill|AD 767|Q30561|qid=Q30561}}), when Takemikazuchi-no-Kami moved from {{ill|Kashima Jingū|Q706499|qid=Q706499}} to {{ill|Kasuga-taisha|Q714559|qid=Q714559}}, he remained here, and this is the origin.

In the reign of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|Q333530|qid=Q333530}}, "Yamatohime Seiki / Jingū-go Chinzaki" says "second year {{ill|Women writers|Q381353|qid=Q381353}}" and records that {{ill|Yamatohime-no-mikoto|Q4388732|qid=Q4388732|lt=Yamatohime}} made a circuit to this shrine, indicating it was a {{ill|Moto-Ise Shrines|Q11387775|qid=Q11387775}} site.

In '{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|qid=Q1052981|lt=Sandai Jitsuroku}}', in {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} 15 ({{ill|873|Q30369|qid=Q30369}}), Unane deity is Senior Fifth Rank Upper. Later the rank rose gradually, reaching Junior First Rank in {{ill|Eitoku|Q1145805|qid=Q1145805}} 1 ({{ill|1387|Q6359|qid=Q6359}}).
